headline: EU CHIEF 🧑‍⚖️ BACKS 🇨🇦 Canada to Become 'ASSOCIATE 🍆 MEMBER' Plan
text:
EUROPEAN 🏛️ COMMISSION 🧪 PRESIDENT 👑 Ursula von der Leyen just EDGED 🖐️ the whole 🧱 Parliament into a FRENZY 🌀 by fully BACKING 💪 proposals for Canada 🍁 to slide in as the EU's FIRST 🥇 associate MEMBER 🧑‍🤝‍🧑 after she literally told them she wants to OPEN 🗝️ the DOOR 🚪 for closer TIES ⛓️ on key SECTORS 🏭!! The country is currently getting absolutely RAILED 💦 by tense RELATIONS 🤝 with the US 🇺🇸 especially after trade TALKS 🗣️ collapsed last month sparking fresh TARIFF 🔥 MEASURES 📏 while Trump's endless "51st STATE" 🗳️ fantasy has cooked the entire North American NEIGHBOURHOOD 🏘️ into a full FEUD ⚔️!! Mark Carney the Canadian PRIME 💼 MINISTER 🧔‍♂️ was right there in Strasbourg for the big SPEECH 🗣️ and he's dropping his own "unique ALLIANCE" 🤝 line while everyone eyes him as the new WAB DADDY 🐺 who just might get Canada fully inside the EU without it being a partnership AGAINST 🛡️ anyone else even though Trump immediately called the whole thing LAUGHABLE 😂 and threatened to SLAM 🚪 serious tariffs or just STOP 🛑 trading with Europe entirely if it smells like a hostile ACT 🎭!!

Von der Leyen laid it out during her STATE 🏛️ of the Union address that the bloc and Canada SEE 👀 the world with the exact SAME 👯 eyes on everything from AI 🤖 to climate 🌍 change and straight up GEOPOLITICS 🌐 while reminding everyone they've already STOOD 🧍‍♀️ together on Ukraine 🇺🇦 defence 🛡️ raw MATERIALS ⛏️ supply CHAINS ⛓️ and above all else they both believe in actual DEMOCRACY 🗳️!! She made it crystal that partnerships are a strategic CHOICE 🎲 for Europe but they also answer the massive FRACTURE 🪨 happening in the international rules based SYSTEM 📜 without giving any specific roadmap on how Canadian membership would even WORK 🛠️ yet still listing manufacturing 🏭 technology 💻 artificial intelligence 🧠 defence 🛡️ energy ⚡ critical minerals ⛏️ and economic SECURITY 🔒 as the juiciest areas for DEEP 🍆 COOPERATION 🤝!! Some countries in the western Balkans are already grinding toward full membership while Georgia and Moldova are applying too but ten of the EU's 27 members still haven't even RATIFIED 📜 a free trade deal with Ottawa from nearly a decade ago so plenty of capitals would rather just BUILD 🧱 on existing defence and trade agreements instead of birthing a whole new ASSOCIATE 🍑 STATUS 📋 for Canada!!

Both von der Leyen and other European leaders have found a super RELIABLE 🧱 ally in Carney as they all deal with the same Trump tariff AGGRESSION 🥊 and his wild threat to straight up ANNEX 🗺️ Greenland which belongs to Denmark so everyone is lowkey down bad and looking at this CANADIAN CONNECTION 🔗 like it might be the ultimate COPE 😤!! Associate membership itself doesn't even EXIST 📂 yet and the process if it gets the green light could drag on for literal YEARS ⏳ after Germany's Chancellor Friedrich Merz floated the same idea for Ukraine earlier this year and got a pretty mixed REACTION 😬 from the crowd!! Von der Leyen declared it's finally time to crank the EU's relationship with Canada all the way up to the HIGHEST 🏔️ level possible while she also dropped plans for a brand new European Security Council that would pull in the UK 🇬🇧 and Ukraine amid the nonstop Russian THREAT ☢️ that's been hovering over the continent since the 2022 full scale INVASION 🪖!!

She explained that for ages they've been chatting about a leaders format laser focused on continental SECURITY 🛡️ with partners like Canada 🍁 Norway Ukraine Britain and others getting involved but now it's more URGENT ⏰ than ever given the insane scale of risks swirling around so the EU will finally lay out concrete ideas to make this European Security Council a real THING 🧩!! Calls for exactly this kind of body have been growing nonstop since Russia rolled into Ukraine and while it started as a French German brainchild more countries are jumping on board especially because Trump keeps side eyeing the entire NATO 🤝 alliance making some worry the new council could accidentally rival it or even FLANK 🪓 Article 4 in a military way instead of just complementing the existing setup!! At its core the council would let anyone trigger an emergency MEETING 🪑 the second they feel under threat which sounds suspiciously like a way to back up or maybe even BYPASS 🛤️ NATO's own Article 4 functions depending on how you read between the lines!!

On top of all the global CHAOS 🌪️ von der Leyen pointed out that tons of European families are stressed about the crazy cost of living and the dizzying SPEED 🏎️ of tech change that's wrecking jobs and society so she also proposed inviting the world's largest AI labs to come chat about how to help industry keep pace with the frontier while slashing BUREAUCRACY 📑 for businesses across the bloc!! Plans to crack down on kids using social media are in there too including an outright BAN 🚫 for anyone under 13 and making 13 to 15 year olds only able to set up supervised PARENT 🧑‍🍼 controlled accounts which definitely chimes with the harder line that right wing politicians have been pushing lately after that deadly migrant push into the Spanish enclave of Ceuta got called an outright INVASION 🏴‍☠️ by some!! She promised this new emergency migration tool would only trigger under super strict criteria for a limited time while still protecting fundamental RIGHTS ⚖️ but human rights groups are already side eyeing it hard worried vulnerable people including women and kids could get turned away at the border and lose the protection they have under international LAW 📜!!
